schemas.title: WaterfallChartData
schemas.description: Data of a waterfall_chart widget: the steps of a running sum, each a labelled change or a total.

steps.description: Two to 24 steps in the delivered order, of the running sum the chart starts at 0. A delta moves the running sum by its value (a negative one down); a null delta draws nothing and leaves the sum unchanged. A total draws the running sum from 0, and the first step may be a total: the start of the sum, its value the sum begins at. A total's own value stays null or the running sum itself, which the widget cross-checks; a step that moves the running sum out of the finite range fails the cell. All bars of no extent shows the empty state.

label.description: The name of the step, which its band writes on the axis.

value.description: The change of a delta step, or the running sum a total step draws: a total's value stays null or the running sum of the steps before it (the widget cross-checks the two, and a mismatch fails the cell naming the step's position). A null delta draws nothing and keeps the sum. A value out of the finite range fails the cell.

kind.description: Whether the step moves the running sum by its value (delta), or draws the running sum from zero (total). Without it, delta.

schemas.title: WaterfallChartRender
schemas.description: Render of a waterfall_chart widget: its presentation fields, closed.

connectors.description: Whether a thin line joins one bar's end to the next bar's start, at the level both stand at. Without it, true.

value_labels.description: Where a bar writes its change over its top edge, formatted by value_format: a delta's change with its sign (+4.1, -2), a total's running sum as the bare value, with no sign. auto writes it when the label fits the band the bar stands in, estimated from its length, and never in a low cell; the label stays in the tooltip, the text alternative and the data view below that. always writes it whatever the band fits, and never writes none. Without it, auto.

drill_down.description: Whether the chart offers its data view and opens it from a click on a bar. Without it, false.
